entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Get me a person, now!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I need to return these garbage cycling shoes I bought. I've never been so disappointed with a product in my life.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

The issue? The issue is they're horribly made! I went for one ride and they gave me massive blisters on my heels. One ride! Are you kidding me? I want a refund, and I want it now. Don't waste my time.

I can certainly understand your frustration with getting blisters. That sounds very uncomfortable, and it's not the experience we want for our customers. Just to rule everything out, was this an issue with the fit, or perhaps the placement of the cleats causing pressure?

Are you serious? Are you trying to blame me? I know how to set up my own cleats! This is a defective product. I'm telling you, if you don't process this return, I will light up every review site and social media platform about this. Get me your manager!
No, that won't be necessary. I can handle this for you. I'm not questioning your experience, I just need to follow the process. Let me just pull up the policy for you right now. One moment, please.

Okay, thank you for holding. I've confirmed in our system that for our cycling shoes, we have a 10-day return window. Since you received them 12 days ago, you are unfortunately outside that period. I can process this for a full refund for you immediately.
So you're actually going to do it? You're giving me the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I am generating a pre-paid return label and it will be sent to the email address on your account within the next few minutes. Just print that out, place the shoes in their original box, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
Fine. That's what you should have done from the start. Make sure that email comes through.
It's already been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
